english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when pressurizing a person or group to make them act.

exampleSentences.english: The boss is always trying to pressurize us into delivering early.
exampleSentences.traditional: 老闆成日畀壓力我哋，要我哋提早交貨。
